RF4.A4.DEF-01.item: A4 cohort / estimand map: A- (failure) / A+ (recovery)

fields.outcome_definition: label_A = lon_ok AND lat_ok (pra_comparison/pra_labels.py:469). Kinematics from vla_misalignment_poc/analysis/trajectory_metrics.py: DT = 0.5 s; v_start = mean speed of first 2 steps, v_end = mean of last 2 steps. Lon class: STOP if total path < 1.0 m AND v_end < 0.5 m/s; if v_start < 0.5 m/s: ACCELERATE iff v_end - v_start > 0.8 m/s else MAINTAIN; else r = v_end/v_start >= 1.25 ACCELERATE, <= 0.75 DECELERATE (STOP if v_end < 0.5), else MAINTAIN. Pred lon class (computed with the GT start speed) must be in the GT tolerance set: GT v_end +- max(0.5 m/s, 15% x max(v_start, v_end)) (11-point grid). Lat class: LEFT/RIGHT if |final lateral offset| > 2.0 m or |final-step heading| > 15 deg (heading ignored if last step < 0.25 m), else STRAIGHT; pred lat class must be in the GT tolerance set (+-1.0 m, +-10 deg). Invalid/short plan -> A- (P1-C: amplification 0, recovery 0)
fields.horizon: applied to the 10-pose / 5 s plan (_pos_to_delta(traj, 10) in analyze_action_history.a_eval) although trajectory_metrics.py documents these thresholds for a 3 s horizon (HORIZON = 6, 'total path length below this over 3 s'); run_pra_comparison.py has a 3 s sensitivity (horizon 6) only for the P/R/A comparison
fields.use_rule: state the formula, thresholds and the 3 s-documented / 5 s-applied fact wherever A- is defined
